title: Great tool but should not be counter clockwise
body: Time Timers are great for keeping kids on task and on schedule. We have had the physical ones for years and the app is a handy extension of that. My only issue with time timers is that they have the minutes counter clockwise. This has caused real difficulties when trying to teach my kids how an analogue clock works as they have become so accustomed to seeing the numbers in the order of the time timer.

title: Great app for achieving focus
body:
For those trying to make the most out of each day, the Time Timer is great for personal sprints. The watch app in particular is a crucial addition, and by far the most useful (as you shouldn’t have your phone visible when trying to focus!).

My experience with the Watch app...

Timer is up: 
• Would like to see a option to quickly reset and restart the timer when time is up. (Currently you have to tap multiple times to reset then restart the clock. Would be great to see a simple 1-tap to go again.)

• More notice when timer is up. (When a timer is up, it only comes through as a notification, and because notifications aren’t prominent, I often miss when a timer is up. Unsure if this is an OS restriction, but a continuous vibration feature similar to an alarm would be amazing!)

title: Fantastic...! But...
body:
Time timer is great. I have a big version that sits on my desk but also this app for when I’m out and about. The only thing that annoys me (which is why it’s a 4 star rating and not 5) is that if you want to use it and visually see time going down, you have to leave your device on. That can drain battery. But it’s worth it if you don’t use it much and have a physical time timer for your desk. 

So glad there’s now an app for Apple Watch and can’t wait to try this out! It will hopefully be more discreet than using a phone.  I like the idea of  leaving your phone for doing other things and keeping the timer on your watch. This could help if you’re easily distracted and tend to close the app on your phone 

I like to use the time timer to get ready before appointments, or make sure I don’t stay in the shower too long. It’s so helpful!
